description: List your GrowSurf program's configured Campaign Rewards, including switched-off rewards and rewards whose group is not selected. Deleted rewards are excluded. A reward can be earned only when it also appears in the campaign response's embedded `rewards` array. These settings do not establish that a participant earned or received a reward; earned reward records belong to the individual participant. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_list_campaign_rewards

rewardEvidence.description: What this response establishes about rewards. Combine with other reads; unknown here does not override evidence elsewhere.

approvalPolicy.description: Referral reward approval policy from requireManualRewardApproval, not affiliate commission approval or an individual reward state.

automaticFulfillmentMarking.description: The autoFulfillRewards setting, when returned by an options read. Null means unknown; this controls marking, not delivery.

rewards.description: The program's configured Campaign Rewards, including switched-off rewards. Deleted rewards are excluded.

items.description: A campaign reward config (`CampaignReward`), distinct from a `ParticipantReward` earned by a participant.

commissionStructure.description: Affiliate commission configuration: `type` (`PERCENT` or `FIXED`), `percent` or `amount` + `amountISO` (in minor currency units (e.g. cents)), `event`, `minPaidReferrals`, `holdDuration` (days), `duration` and `durationInMonths`, `approvalRequired`, plus optional cap (`maxAmount`) and intro rate (`intro*`) fields. Present only for affiliate programs.

conversionsRequired.description: Referrals required to earn this reward.

couponCode.description: Legacy static coupon code shown to the referrer in the reward-won email and webhook. Display text only; superseded by a connected billing integration's issued coupon.

description.description: The reward description shown to the referrer.

event.description: The referral event that earns this Campaign Reward. `LEAD` means a referred signup; `CONVERSION` means a qualifying action.

isUnlimited.description: `true` if a participant can earn this reward an unlimited number of times.

isVisible.description: Whether the reward is enabled. When `false` it is no longer awarded and is hidden from participants.

limit.description: How many times a participant can earn this reward. `-1` represents unlimited in REST responses.

nextMilestonePrefix.description: Text shown before the referral count in milestone progress copy. `MILESTONE` rewards only.

nextMilestoneSuffix.description: Text shown after the referral count in milestone progress copy. `MILESTONE` rewards only.

numberOfWinners.description: Maximum number of winners. `LEADERBOARD` rewards only.

order.description: Display order when there are multiple rewards.

referralCouponCode.description: Legacy static coupon code shown to the referred friend (double-sided rewards). Display text only; superseded by a connected billing integration's issued coupon.

referralDescription.description: The reward description shown to the referred friend (double-sided rewards only).

referredRewardUpfront.description: Double-sided rewards only. When `true`, the referred friend's reward is delivered upfront as a discount.

referredValue.description: Tax valuation used by tax documentation and 1099 reporting. `null` when no valuation is set.

fairMarketValueUSD.description: Manual fair-market value in USD (major units). `null` when no manual value is set.

taxCharacter.description: The reason the recipient earns the reward. For configurable non-commission rewards, `null` inherits the program's confirmed treatment. Commission rewards always use `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES`.

title.description: The reward title (internal only, never shown to participants).

value.description: Tax valuation used by tax documentation and 1099 reporting. `null` when no valuation is set.

fairMarketValueUSD.description: Manual fair-market value in USD (major units). `null` when no manual value is set.

taxCharacter.description: The reason the recipient earns the reward. For configurable non-commission rewards, `null` inherits the program's confirmed treatment. Commission rewards always use `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES`.

title: List Campaign Rewards
